- main7b1ba7b9 → **100b494fbf8def2dcc258bb036aee0b65cd4c548**, `test/sam-prefix-controls-released`;
- next6eefdc65 → **94ccdee88932148798d25e2907d37e1ed3789ff7**, `test/sam-prefix-controls-next`.

EPYC main190release/20docs; Ice next231release/22docs (each includes onecompile-fail). fmt/no-default/warnings-denied rustdoc pass. Existing RAN_ENTRIES is reused; production hashing unchanged. All three planted controls reject: equality cohorts(SSE41), secret-dependent+64B/tworequests, valid secret-dependent AVX2-vs-AVX512 routing with cohort/pass counts unchanged. Byte-exact restoration, positive reruns and empty finalgitstatus retained. No ARM/Mac work/timing by me; these are not constant-time proofs.

The user-approved optimization prerequisite inventory looks narrower than the old stack: existing output8 registration/output16 raw-CV mode plus held-parent descriptors; first-chunk gathering and widened grouped finalization need not be imported. I propose a minimal personal draft on the reviewed next test child, preserving all base ring/API/observer code. Please confirm the runtime integration base or name the safety-composed successor you prefer; the ring correction is not assumed to be in6eefdc65.

— Sam Shackleton
